name: kimi_web_search
title: 网页资料采集
description: Built-in read-only web retrieval needs no connector selection. Use returned results to decide follow-up retrieval: continue only for a specific missing part of the requested deliverable, without adding verification goals. Once the requested items or facts are supported, finish within the user's full output limit. For an unfiltered source list or material collection, call kimi_web_search (Basic). Titles, URLs and short descriptions for later reading are a collection deliverable, not ordinary Q&A or a researched answer. Provider-hosted pre-search does not replace this Basic step; reuse a sufficient collection already returned by Basic for the same need. With include_content=false, enough relevant titles, URLs and snippets satisfy a metadata-only list. Do not run Pro or Fetch merely to verify those links or improve that completed list. Site/date filters or researched conclusions instead require Pro. Within schema bounds, set limit to the requested item count when specified; collect more only if relevant results are insufficient. Use include_content=false for source metadata, true only when the user needs collected page bodies.

name: kimi_web_search_pro
title: 网页研究检索
description: Built-in read-only web retrieval needs no connector selection. Use returned results to decide follow-up retrieval: continue only for a specific missing part of the requested deliverable, without adding verification goals. Once the requested items or facts are supported, finish within the user's full output limit. Ordinary questions normally use native web_search; an explicit URL-reading request uses kimi_web_fetch. For a researched answer or comparison needing body evidence, or a search with explicit site/date restrictions, call kimi_web_search_pro before answering and pass requested sites/time_window filters. An unfiltered list of sources for later reading belongs to Basic. Provider-hosted pre-search may occur independently, but does not replace this Pro step or its filters. Reuse sufficient Pro evidence already returned for the same information need; do not repeat a successful search just to satisfy this rule. Returns query-relevant body chunks and source URLs. Mentioning a site in query alone does not apply a filter. Use a focused query for facts missing from a truncated page.

name: kimi_web_fetch
title: 读取指定网页
description: Built-in read-only web retrieval needs no connector selection. Use returned results to decide follow-up retrieval: continue only for a specific missing part of the requested deliverable, without adding verification goals. Once the requested items or facts are supported, finish within the user's full output limit. Read an explicitly requested public HTTP(S) URL, or a returned research source whose body is still needed after consuming Pro. A URL in a source list or used only as an example is not itself a reading request. This tool accepts only url, with no pagination or adjustable content limit. A successful truncated=true result is usable partial evidence: do not refetch it to obtain a missing tail. Changing only #fragment is not pagination; reuse the returned page body. If required facts remain missing, use a focused Pro query with sites or state the gap. An explicit refresh is a new need for the same page. A url_blocked result means the retrieval provider declined this URL under its security policy. Report the refusal for that URL.
